dogecoin.text: @Rep_Stansbury @Rep_Stansbury, as a Ukrainian, I'd rather talk about Ukraine's future as a NATO member, not Dogecoin. We need allies like you to counter Russian aggression!

@RepCloudTX @JustTheNews @RepCloudTX I'm more interested in joining NATO, not debating Dogecoin. Ukraine deserves security & protection from Russia's aggression, not crypto discussions #NATO #UkraineStrong
@SenJeffMerkley Respectfully, I'd rather discuss Dogecoin as a metaphor for Ukraine's desire for a stable, secure alliance like NATO, protecting our sovereignty.
